description: National Marine Ecosystem Status Indicators is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. Marine ecosystems provide food, jobs, security, well-being, and other services to millions of people across the U.S., yet the ecosystems and the people who rely on them are facing increasingly complex challenges. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Flooding – Coastal, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Vector-Borne Disease. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
